description: Call any Vastu Shastra operation directly by its path suffix under /v2/astrology/vastu/ — for the long tail of the 143-operation surface not covered by the dedicated vastu_* tools. Examples: "entrance/recommend", "entrance/pada", "entrance/obstruction-check", "placement/borewell", "placement/main-gate", "score/overall", "score/zone-wise", "specialized/temple", "timing/grihapravesh", "timing/bhumi-pujan", "plot/shape", "plot/slope", "compound/wall-analysis", "elements/distribution", "plan/analyze", "plan/optimize", "direction/sun-path", "ar/true-north-calibrate". Prefer a dedicated vastu_* tool when your need matches one.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for assessments/batch. Retain the same key for retries of one logical batch; use a new key for a new batch. Sent as the Idempotency-Key header, outside the body.

op.description: Path suffix under /v2/astrology/vastu/, e.g. "score/overall" or "placement/borewell". A leading slash or surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

params.description: Request body for the operation. Shape depends on the operation.

name: vastu_operation
